exposure: Genotype for 18 haplotype-tagging single-nucleotide polymorphisms in OXTR and 7 haplotype-tagging single-nucleotide polymorphisms in GRK6
Genetic variation in the gene encoding G protein-coupled receptor kinase 6 (GRK6)
Genetic variation in the oxytocin receptor (OXTR)
cohort: Pregnant women with a singleton gestation undergoing induction of labor at 36 weeks or greater
finding: Genetic variation in OXTR and GRK6 is associated with the amount of oxytocin required, duration of labor, and risk for cesarean delivery among women undergoing induction of labor near term.
mod_finding: Three single-nucleotide polymorphisms, two in OXTR and one in GRK6, showed nominal significance with mode of delivery.
